subject: Reminder: Upcoming Team Meeting
body: Dear team members, Just a friendly reminder that we have our monthly team meeting scheduled for this Friday at 10:00 AM. The agenda will include updates on ongoing projects, upcoming deadlines, and team initiatives. Please make sure to come prepared with any reports or updates you would like to share with the team. If you have any scheduling conflicts, please let me know as soon as possible. Looking forward to a productive meeting. Best regards, [Your Name]
